# Create and destroy multiple effects

Source: [4849](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4849); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4849-n1"></a>

- Capture Last Created Entity immediately after each effect and store IDs in a player-owned array for selective cleanup.

<a id="wiki-4849-n2"></a>

- Append To Array creates a new array, so its result must be assigned back to mutate stored state.

<a id="wiki-4849-n3"></a>

- Destroy Effect can accept the stored array, after which clear that array; avoid Destroy All Effects when unrelated effects exist.

<a id="wiki-4849-n4"></a>

- Example gates activation on an empty Effects array and uses Ignore Condition to reach delayed cleanup.

Source limitations:

- Date-dependent array-accepting Destroy Effect capability should be validated; guide says introduced by a recent update.
